# Giriraaj Textiles

## Overview
Giriraaj Textiles is a yarn manufacturer in Beawar, Rajasthan (Ajmer region), established in 2025. Proprietorship led by S Agarwal. Up to 10 employees. GST registered in 2025.

## Products
- Recycled polyester yarn (synthetic): 3-ply, counts 10, 12, and 15. MOQ 1,000 cones. Colours include white, cream, blue, and more on request.
- Polypropylene (PP) bag closing thread. Further specifications available on call.

## Typical use
Closing and stitching HDP bags and other industrial bags on bag-closing machines such as Revo.

## Lead handling
Enquiry replies within 12 hours.
